title: Covariance-Specific Coefficient Identification in Linear Models with Bounded Directed Fan-In
banked_reason: The proved exact rational-covariance frontier is sound, but the hard-side novelty is the bounded-fan-in replacement of Dörfler et al.'s storage star; without stability, finite-sample inference, implementation, or substantive MIIVsem evidence, the cold referee capped it at subfield (7.0), below the field floor (7.4).
proof_attempt_summary: The run completed and independently reviewed an exact all-covariance fan-in-one classification with constructive certificates, a fiber-bijective fan-in-two hardness compiler on bounded depth-one components, and exact-fiber padding consequences for fixed K_G. The mathematical and rubric reviewers passed the package, but the cold significance referee capped it at subfield because the hard-side delta is narrow and the package does not deliver approximate-covariance stability, finite-sample inference, implementation, or applied validation. Those additions remain possible follow-on work, but require new research beyond an in-scope derivation repair.
tldr: A covariance-specific coefficient can be generically recoverable yet ambiguous or singular at the supplied covariance. Maximum directed indegree one is the exact tractable side: a deterministic polynomial-bit algorithm normalizes every bi-affine fiber into pole-aware Möbius components and a singular-relation \(2\)-CNF, returning a unique rational coefficient, two unequal feasible witnesses, or a componentwise quadratic nonconstant-curve certificate. At indegree two, promise \(\forall\mathbb R\)-completeness already holds for depth-one directed graphs whose directed weak components are isolated vertices, single edges, or two-parent in-stars. Exact-fiber padding gives a hard subproblem \(\mathcal R_0\) inside \(\mathsf{NUMEDGE}_3\) with \(K_G=0\); the full literal zero-parameter class is larger because \(K_G=0\) does not bound vertices of indegree at least three. The full class is complete by the \(k=0\) specialization of the all-fixed-\(k\) theorem, while \(\mathcal R_0\) is separately complete by the padded reduction and restricted universal-real membership. The private-parent and occurrence-hub compiler is exactly fiber-bijective and has rational strictly diagonally dominant covariance. Dörfler et al. already provide fiber bijectivity; the strict hard-side delta is replacing their shared unbounded-fan-in storage star by components of size at most three.
gap: Complete low-fan-in algorithms are generic and may divide by expressions that vanish at the observed covariance, whereas the published numerical-identification completeness construction permits unbounded directed fan-in and does not provide the bounded-fan-in fiber bijection required here.
fill: The Möbius-component and singular-clause normal form proves exact tractability with checkable low-degree certificates, while the private-slot compiler preserves the full source fiber at maximum directed indegree two. Rational strict diagonal dominance and the planted feasible matrix are construction normalizations, not separate novelty claims.
